title: Semi-rational Engineering of Xylulokinase from Lactococcus lactis N8 for Enhanced Catalytic Efficiency via Synergistic Hotspot Mutations.
authors: Ai, Yaqian; Geng, Tao; Chen, Wenjie; Montalban-Lopez, Manuel; Li, Xingjiang; Mu, Dongdong
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文通过半理性设计结合分子对接和MD模拟改造木酮糖激酶，虽以酶催化效率提升为目标，但涉及蛋白质结构计算建模，方法可迁移至蛋白结构相关研究。
abstract: Efficient xylose bioconversion is limited by the catalytic performance of xylulokinase (XylB), which phosphorylates d-xylulose to xylulose-5-phosphate. This study aimed to improve XylB from Lactococcus lactis N8 using a multi-dimensional semi-rational design strategy integrating sequence conservation, structure-based screening, mutagenesis, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations. Asn301 was identified as a key functional hotspot, and Met259 was found to modulate the active-site hydrophobic environment. Combinatorial mutagenesis generated two superior variants, XylBM259H/N301G and XylBM259H/N301H, with more than 200% higher specific activity than the wild-type XylB (XylBWT) while retaining stable expression and environmental adaptability. Mechanistic analyses showed strengthened ATP binding, improved d-xylulose positioning, enhanced ligand affinity, and balanced local flexibility with structural compactness. These findings provide efficient XylB variants and a transferable strategy for engineering lignocellulose-related enzymes.
abstract_zh: 木糖高效生物转化受限于木酮糖激酶（XylB）的催化性能，该酶将d-木酮糖磷酸化为木酮糖-5-磷酸。本研究旨在通过整合序列保守性、基于结构的筛选、诱变、分子对接和分子动力学模拟的多维半理性设计策略，改善来自乳酸乳球菌N8的XylB。Asn301被鉴定为关键功能热点，Met259被发现调节活性位点的疏水环境。组合诱变产生了两个优良变体，XylBM259H/N301G和XylBM259H/N301H，其比活性比野生型XylB（XylBWT）提高超过200%，同时保持稳定表达和环境适应性。机制分析显示，ATP结合增强、d-木酮糖定位改善、配体亲和力提高，以及局部灵活性与结构紧凑性的平衡。这些发现提供了高效的XylB变体，以及一种可转移的工程化木质纤维素相关酶的策略。
